Name: RFP for Plan Bay Area 2060 Regional Growth Forecast Development Services

Details.Project: RFP for Plan Bay Area 2060 Regional Growth Forecast Development Services

Description:
Please review or download the Notice of Upcoming Opportunity under the Files tab for details on this upcoming opportunity.





MTC and ABAG are jointly responsible for preparing a long-range regional plan for the nine-county Bay Area in order to satisfy federal and state planning requirements. The current long-range plan is entitled Plan Bay Area 2060+ and was adopted by MTC and ABAG in March 2026.





The Metropolitan Transportation Commission is seeking to hire a consultant to provide technical services to support development of the Regional Growth Forecast for Plan Bay Area 2060, the Bay Area’s long-range regional plan for transportation, housing, and the environment.  The Project is expected to begin on January 1, 2027, and be completed by March 31, 2029.

Name: (UPCOMING) RFP for 2026 511 and Express Lanes Operational Services

Details.Project: (UPCOMING) RFP for 2026 511 and Express Lanes Operational Services

Description: [UPCOMING: August 2026] Metropolitan Transportation Commission (MTC), invites your firm to submit a proposal for 511 and Express Lanes Operational Services. As a result of this RFP, MTC intends to contract with an Operational Services Contractor (“OS Contractor”) to provide staffing and management services, collectively “operational services,” for MTC’s 511 Operations Center and Express Lanes Operations Center, in support of real-time operations for MTC’s 511 Traveler Information and Bay Area Express Lanes Programs. It is MTC’s intent that the selected OS Contractor will staff both operations centers and will provide coordination and management between the two functional areas. The OS Contractor will be responsible for ensuring that staffing coverage is provided during normal operating hours as well as during emergency conditions affecting the transportation network.  Additionally, the OS Contractor will be required to coordinate with Caltrans District 4, California Highway Patrol (CHP), local transit agencies, and other MTC contractors.  The staff in the 511 Operations Center and the Express Lane Operations Center are not currently unionized. Dates are preliminary until procurement documents are finalized. See "Notice of Upcoming Procurement" for additional details.

Name: UPCOMING -- RFP for Regional Safety Operations Program Development and Capacity Building

Details.Project: UPCOMING -- RFP for Regional Safety Operations Program Development and Capacity Building

Description: The Metropolitan Transportation Commission (MTC) works in partnership with the California Highway Patrol (CHP), Caltrans, and other regional counterparts to improve safety, mobility, and operational coordination across the Bay Area transportation system. A key component of this effort is the Bay Area Incident Management Task Force (IMTF), a multidisciplinary partnership that advances regional collaboration, information sharing, and operational best practices among agencies responsible for managing incidents and supporting safe, reliable transportation networks. MTC seeks consultant support to strengthen organizational systems, stakeholder engagement, leadership development opportunities, and performance management practices that underpin program success. The goal of this effort is to build long-term organizational capacity, reduce ongoing administrative burden, and create a scalable foundation that enables MTC staff to focus on strategic leadership and program advancement.
